in_sanskrit.name: Biplab
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Struggle, Battle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Biplab एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Biplab is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘bip’ meaning struggle or battle, and ‘labh’ meaning to gain or acquire. This name signifies the struggle one undergoes to achieve success or gain something valuable.
